props.name: duration
props.description: Time in milliseconds a toast remains visible before auto-dismissing. `0` disables it.

props.name: expandByDefault
props.description: When `true`, the toast stack starts in the expanded state.

props.name: label
props.description: An author-localized label for each toast.

slots.name: default
slots.type: { expanded: boolean; count: number; expand: () => void; collapse: () => void; }
